app.name: SwiftTalks
app.tagline: Your companion app for Swift community events and conferences
app.description: SwiftTalks is a comprehensive mobile app designed for the Swift developer community to discover, prepare, and engage with talks and conferences.

features.title: Talks
features.description: Browse and discover talks from various Swift community upcoming and past events

features.title: Past Events
features.description: Access resources, sample codes and other materials from previous talks

features.title: Speaker Details
features.description: View detailed profiles of speakers and their sessions

features.title: Global Conferences
features.description: Stay updated with Swift conferences from around the world

features.title: Encourage First Time Speakers
features.description: Resources and support for new speakers in the community

features.title: Prepare Content
features.description: Learn how to create and organize your talk content efficiently

features.title: Record & Rehearse
features.description: Practice and record your talks with built-in rehearsal tools

features.title: More Communities
features.description: Discover other Swift communities across india

features.title: Latest News
features.description: Stay informed with the latest Swift ecosystem news, articles, blog posts, tutorials etc.

features.title: System Status
features.description: Check the current status of apple systems

features.title: Software Releases
features.description: Track the latest Apple software releases

features.title: Roadmap
features.description: View upcoming features and community roadmap
